title: Organize a Raw Excel Range into a data.frame, matrix, list or table — xlParseRange
text: Single range. requested structure determines result: "data.frame" header = TRUE first row supplies column names; otherwise names V1, V2, .... "matrix" whole range matrix. convert TRUE every column numeric, numeric matrix results; otherwise character matrix. "list" one component per column (named header header = TRUE). "table" first column becomes row names, first row becomes column names, top-left corner cell discarded. result matrix dimnames (table object). Requires least 2 rows 2 columns. Multiple areas. x list "XLRange" blocks (disjoint selection), two targets supported: "list" area parsed matrix; result list matrices. "data.frame" area parsed data.frame areas bound column-wise single data.frame. Columns unequal length padded NA longest column, duplicate column names disambiguated make.unique. target raises error multi-area input.

pons (development version)
text: Interface R Microsoft Word Excel via Component Object Model, supplying Office layer DescToolsX package suite. Windows ; requires local Office installation RDCOMClient. toWrd() writes content common R classes running Word document, control font, paragraph format, style template bullet lists. Bookmark handling makes reports updatable place: wrdAddBookmark(), wrdBookmark(), renameBookmark(), wrdDeleteBookmark(), bookmarkList() wrdGoto(). replaceBookmarkText() restores bookmark Word discards underlying text replaced. xlGetRange() xlParseRange() read Excel selection - including disjoint multi-area selections - data frame, matrix, list table, header handling per-column type detection. xlImport() wraps Tcl/Tk dialog either assigns result inserts constructive R code editor cursor. xlView() opens data frames, matrices, tables, vectors nested lists Excel, methods lm glm write coefficient table optional confidence intervals, ANOVA fitted values.
